title: Section adjunction with explicit target carriers
statement: For the normalized geometric adjunction g of [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] and charts of [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], define sectionAdjoint(h,n,U,x) to be adjointSection(h,n,U,x), with its target carrier explicitly written as sections of N at (n,chart f U). The compatibility theorem identifies this computed value heterogeneously with the original adjointSection.

source.place: paragraph (1), sectionwise ordinary adjunction used in the twisted unit square

proof.text: Compute the ordinary adjoint, evaluate at n, postcompose with ordinaryPushEvaluation and evaluate on U. The existing direct-image functor retains exactly the target section carrier; the wrapper is definitionally this composite. The compatibility is reflexivity.

def sectionAdjoint
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    {M : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)} {N : Systems X (Arings l E X)}
    (h : g.pull.obj M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : M.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))) :
    N.val.obj (op (n, (chart f U).unop))
